messages.content: tumi ki mone koro age gap relationship e problem hoy?
Not inherently, but different life stages can create friction sometimes - career priorities, social circle, long-term goals. Tumi ki eta niye bhabcho personally?
hae, amar theke 8 bochor boro ekjon er sathe kotha hocche
8 years is meaningful but not extreme. Life stage ta ki khub different lagche - jemon tumi career shuru korcho ar se already established?
hae exactly emon e, ami sesh e amar career shuru korchi, se already onek established

That mismatch is worth talking about openly early, not avoiding. Different pace e thakleo relationship work korte pare jodi dujon e respect kore onno jon er timeline, kintu eta assume kora na kore directly discuss kora dorkar.
